GlyphPhase.description: Phase of a glyph's line style (K30: dashed candidate, solid final, outcome).

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

oneOf.description: Devam: the move goes on (trend, MA alignment, flag).
Dönüş: the move may be turning (divergence, double top/bottom).
Kırılım: a boundary was crossed (range, channel, support/resistance).
Sıkışma: the move is narrowing; direction unknown (band squeeze, low volatility).
Aşırılık: unusual stretch (overbought/oversold, outside the band).
Akış: money in/out independent of price (volume, settlement, institutional flow).

Validity.description:
Whether a capsule's claim still holds **today** (R4, K42/A28; `docs/CONCEPTS.md`
"Geçerlilik"). The headline and the glyph say the same thing.

oneOf.description: Geçerli: the story is open and its state condition holds (or it has none).

Artık geçerli değil: the state condition no longer holds; the story is not
closed yet (its expected resolution is still pending).
Kapandı: the story closed (realized, invalidated, expired or retracted).

description: Parameters of one meaning glyph (K30 visual channels). All engine-derived.

confidence.description: Fill: confidence from the ledger in `[0, 1]`; absent when the ledger is too small.

confirmations.description: Confirmation marks: number of independent evidence families (1–5).

validity.description:
(R4, K42/A28) Validity today, when the producer knows it (it needs the bars and
the state condition, not only the story). An alphabet draws a mark only for
[`Validity::NoLonger`]; `valid` and `closed` look as before (closed is the
phase). Absent: unknown, drawn as before.
